svg.text: DEVELOPMENT EXPLORATION (PROP-0008) - not approved design, not reference art
Three bumps on a slab: the emoji / weather-app
cloud. Every AI cloud converges here.
Wide marshmallow loaf, corner puffs, centred curl.
- weakest cloud read (pillow / bread / sheep body)
- symmetric: no facing direction in silhouette
Wide low body + ONE big Top Puff + curl.
+ reads as a real cumulus tower (flat base, one tower)
+ Top Puff is an acting antenna: perks, leans,
droops, tucks - mood reads even in silhouette
+ unique notch at 32px; shows facing direction
- asymmetric: mirror-flip drift risk (drift check D04)
- a second dome beside Tekla's dome (weak pair)
- top-knot swirl drifts toward the poop-emoji
silhouette: curl must never spiral upward
